cases.name: Melanie Davis
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / daughter's partner
cases.narrative: Zachary waited until she had fallen asleep and swung at her head with a huge sledgehammer, hitting her over and over until he was sure she was dead. She woke after the first blow to the head. As she gasped for air and began experiencing seizures, he continued to strike her head with the sledgehammer. Zach next attempted to set his home on fire. Using a mixture of whiskey and gas to get the fire going, Zach has claimed his hope was that his brother Josh would burn alive inside the house, alongside his mom's corpse. But Josh smelled smoke and fled the house before it was too late.
